item.title: Vassell y Spurs se reponen a mala noche de Wemby y superan 110-107 a Raptors para hilar 10mo triunfo
item.description: TORONTO (AP) — Devin Vassell anotó 21 puntos, De’Aaron Fox sumó 20 y los Spurs de San Antonio se sobrepusieron a una mala noche de Victor Wembanyama para superar el miércoles 110-107 a los Raptors de Toronto. item.title: Dear Abby: Family’s black sheep needs their help
item.description: My siblings all give generously to food banks and homeless charities, even putting some homeless people up in hotels, which is great. But not one of them thinks to ask me if I have enough food or anything.

item.title: Celtics turn in season-worst shooting performance in loss to Nuggets
item.description: The Celtics stalled out in the final game of their West Coast road trip, turning in a season-worst shooting performance in a loss to the Nuggets.
